Training

TEEX training

Training available; current credit eligibility needs review. Do not assume the historically advertised cybersecurity track totals remain earnable for college credit.

Research profile · confirm exact school and course acceptance

How the credit works

Designated TEEX training has had ACE recommendations; an active recommendation covering a prospective November 2026 completion was not verified.

Pace and learning format

Self-paced and instructor-led options; enrollment windows, identity and citizenship conditions vary by offering.

Costs to check

Some DHS/FEMA-funded cybersecurity training is no-cost; other training is paid. Free access does not establish a current transferable award.

Check the current checkout terms and the costs that apply to your actual course list. Membership time, assessments, materials, retakes, transcripts, and school fees may need separate attention.

Assessments and requirements

Course-specific content and post-tests apply. Check current examination, badge and transcript requirements; universal proctoring details were not established.

Before you commit

  • Choose the exact receiving school, degree, and catalog year.
  • Confirm this specific course, recommendation or transcript source—not only the provider’s name.
  • Ask which requirement the learning will satisfy and check duplicate-credit, grade, date, and source limits.
  • Keep a written school decision before paying for an outside course you need for graduation.
